cooperation--noun.def: The act of working together for a shared aim.

sophisticated--adj.def: Advanced and complicated, or having refined taste.

manual--adj.def: Done with the hands rather than by machine.

manual--noun.def: A book that explains how to use something.
manual--noun.ex: Check the manual for the code.

elegant--adj.def: Attractive in a graceful and simple way.
elegant--adj.ex: She wore an elegant grey dress.

revolutionary--adj.def: Completely new and causing great change.

stamp--verb.def: To press a mark onto paper, or to put your foot down hard.

crucial--adj.def: Extremely important because everything depends on it.

torch--noun.def: A small electric lamp you carry, or a burning stick.
torch--noun.ex: Take a torch into the cave.

fulfill--verb.def: To do what was promised or required.

transmission--noun.def: The act of sending something out, or the spread of a disease.

panel--noun.def: A flat board, or a group chosen to discuss or judge.

tolerate--verb.def: To accept something you do not like without complaining.

welfare--noun.def: The health and happiness of people, or state help for them.

devoted--adj.def: Giving all your love or attention to someone.

circuit--noun.def: A path that electricity flows around, or a full lap.
circuit--noun.ex: A broken circuit stopped the lights.

pastor--noun.def: A Christian minister in charge of a church.

pose--noun.def: The position you hold for a photograph or a painting.
pose--noun.ex: Hold that pose for a moment.

evolution--noun.def: The slow development of living things over long periods.

bartender--noun.def: A person who serves drinks in a bar.

regard--noun.def: Respect or a good opinion of someone.
regard--noun.ex: She is held in high regard.

son-in-law--noun.ex: His son in law runs the shop.

melody--noun.def: A tune, the main line of a piece of music.
melody--noun.ex: The melody stays in your head.

fluid--adj.def: Able to flow, or likely to change.

translation--noun.def: A text changed from one language into another.

divided--adj.def: Separated into parts, or not agreeing.

crab--noun.def: A sea animal with a hard shell and ten legs.
crab--noun.ex: A crab hid under the rock.

update--noun.def: The newest information, or a new version of software.

cottage--noun.def: A small simple house in the country.
cottage--noun.ex: They rented a cottage for a week.

backyard--noun.def: The area of ground behind a house.
backyard--noun.ex: The children play in the backyard.

rash--adj.def: Done too quickly without thinking of the result.
rash--adj.ex: Do not make a rash promise.

honorable--adj.def: Deserving respect for being honest and fair.

dip--verb.def: To put something into a liquid briefly.
dip--verb.ex: Dip the bread in the sauce.

trophy--noun.def: A prize, often a silver cup, given to a winner.
trophy--noun.ex: The trophy stands on the shelf.

toxic--adj.def: Containing poison and harmful to health.

pudding--noun.def: A sweet dish eaten at the end of a meal.

rally--noun.def: A large public meeting, or a car race on rough roads.

corporation--noun.def: A large company or group of companies.

disorder--noun.def: An illness of the body or mind, or a lack of order.

cease--verb.def: To stop happening, in formal English.

regardless--adv.def: Without paying attention to a problem or a rule.

deliberately--adv.def: On purpose rather than by accident.

starve--verb.def: To suffer or die because you have no food.
starve--verb.exTr: O kış birçok hayvan açlıktan öldü.

olive--noun.def: A small bitter fruit used for food and oil.
olive--noun.ex: The olive harvest starts in November.

biological--adj.def: Relating to living things and the science of life.

sincere--adj.def: Honest and really meaning what you say.

pad--noun.def: A number of sheets of paper joined, or soft protective material.
pad--noun.ex: He wrote it on a small pad.

sketch--verb.def: To draw something quickly without detail.
sketch--verb.ex: She sketched the harbour in pencil.

parliament--noun.def: The group of people who make a country's laws.
parliament--noun.ex: Parliament passed the law in May.

plead--verb.def: To beg for something, or to state a case in court.

pursuit--noun.def: The act of chasing or trying to achieve something.

replacement--noun.def: A person or thing that takes the place of another.

bombing--noun.def: An attack in which bombs are dropped or placed.

dash--noun.def: A short line in writing, or a small amount added.

gangster--noun.def: A member of a violent criminal group.
gangster--noun.ex: The film is about a gangster.

objective--adj.def: Based on facts rather than personal feeling.

corridor--noun.def: A long passage with rooms on each side.

database--noun.def: An organized store of information on a computer.

relevant--adj.def: Connected with what is being discussed.

identical--adj.def: Exactly the same in every detail.

consistent--adj.def: Always behaving the same way, or not contradicting.

straighten--verb.def: To make something straight or tidy.

legitimate--adj.def: Allowed by law, or fair and reasonable.

expedition--noun.def: An organized journey with a special purpose.

brake--verb.def: To slow a vehicle using the brakes.
brake--verb.ex: He braked hard at the corner.

substance--noun.ex: A sticky substance covered the floor.

corrupt--adj.def: Willing to act dishonestly for money or power.
corrupt--adj.ex: A corrupt official took the money.

investigator--noun.def: A person whose job is to find out the truth.

thread--noun.def: A thin line of cotton, or a series of online messages.

institution--noun.def: A large organization such as a bank or a university.

immortal--adj.def: Living for ever, or never forgotten.

desperately--adv.def: In a way that shows great need or fear.

alcoholic--noun.def: A person who cannot stop drinking alcohol.
alcoholic--noun.ex: He admitted he was an alcoholic.
